map.根据遗址范围与探方规格计算探方数量、发掘面积与各探方坐标（西南角为原点，北为 X: Compute the number of test squares, excavation area, and square coordinates from the site extent and square size (southwest corner as origin, north as positive X, east as positive Y)
map.布方时按遗址范围与发掘计划确定探方规格（常用 5×5m 或 10×10m），计算: When laying out, set the test square size from the site extent and excavation plan (commonly 5×5 m or 10×10 m), compute the number of squares and total excavation area, and assign the square numbers.
map.建立统一坐标网格：以遗址西南角为原点，北为 X 正向、东为 Y 正向，将每个探方: Establish a unified coordinate grid: take the southwest corner of the site as the origin, with north as the positive X direction and east as the positive Y direction, and record each square's southwest corner coordinates (such as T0503 = X50 Y30) in the square register.
map.矩形遗址用取整加边界法：行数=ceil(南北长/规格)、列数=ceil(东西宽/: For a rectangular site use rounding plus a boundary check: rows=ceil(north-south length/size) and columns=ceil(east-west width/size), then subtract the corner squares that fall entirely outside the site.

The southwest corner square is recorded as T0000 (or T0101 by convention), with column numbers increasing eastward and row numbers increasing northward.

map.探方编号 T0503 是什么意思？: What Does the Test Square Number T0503 Mean?
map.常见约定中 T 后四位或两位数字分别表示 X、Y 坐标的十米/五米格。例如 5m: A common convention uses the last four or two digits after T to give the X and Y coordinates in ten-metre or five-metre cells. For example with 5 m squares T0503 means the southwest corner sits at X=50 m, Y=30 m; the exact digits and origin follow the site's excavation plan.
map.为什么探方要统一规格？: Why Must Test Squares Be a Uniform Size?
map.统一规格便于层位、遗物出土单位（context）横向对比与面积统计，也方便后期用: A uniform size makes strata and artifact contexts comparable across the site and simplifies area statistics and later GIS replay by coordinates. Mixed sizes make stratigraphic divisions and artifact densities incomparable.
